nodes.label: admin_audit fail-closed audit log
nodes.rationale: Durable intent inserted before mutation; audit failure prevents the write; pending outcome is unknown, not success, because standalone MongoDB lacks multi-document transactions

nodes.label: admin_mutation_locks serialization
nodes.rationale: Prevents two admins disabling/demoting each other concurrently; pending locks have no TTL and fail closed with 409 ADMIN_ACTION_IN_PROGRESS

nodes.label: Read-only inspection instead of impersonation
nodes.rationale: Avoids credential impersonation

nodes.label: sessionVersion immediate revocation
nodes.rationale: Monotonic boundary revoking access/refresh tokens on block, revoke or role change

nodes.label: Super Admin role (platformRole)
nodes.rationale: Only authenticated SUPER_ADMIN may enter /admin; no default admin or registration escalation

nodes.label: Marketing email consent and suppression
nodes.rationale: Owner-recorded, address-bound; SMS-only or legacy consent never qualifies

nodes.label: WhatsApp followups module (modules/followups)
nodes.rationale: Manual owner action only; consent separate; loopback mock outside production

nodes.label: Session-bound re-authentication
nodes.rationale: Proof bound to session id, user and sessionVersion; 5 minutes

nodes.label: Append-only support_access_log
nodes.rationale: Mongoose hooks insufficient; needs DB role insert/find only

nodes.label: Support grant
nodes.rationale: Tenant customer data is default-deny; owner-approved, time-limited, scoped

nodes.label: Atomic claim with idempotent replay
nodes.rationale: Claim and audit event in one document so replica-set transactions are unnecessary

nodes.label: Independent emailed verification challenge
nodes.rationale: No trusted global emailVerified flag exists

nodes.label: Fragment-based token URLs
nodes.rationale: Keeps tokens out of request logs and returnUrl

nodes.label: Reward state machine
nodes.rationale: Single authoritative lifecycle; enabled derived; transport state separate

nodes.label: Hash-only tokens with HMAC nonce derivation
nodes.norm_label: hash-only tokens with hmac nonce derivation
nodes.rationale: Allows exact idempotent retry without persisting raw tokens

nodes.label: campaigns:indexes migration CLI
nodes.rationale: Explicit migration because production disables auto-indexing; workers refuse to run with CAMPAIGN_INDEXES_MISSING

nodes.label: Additive indexes and outbox recovery
nodes.rationale: Do not run syncIndexes() on production as it can remove unrelated indexes
